blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multimodal retrieval must integrate complementary evidence from views that may be missing, noisy, or unequally informative. When a sample provides limited reliable evidence, learning from its views alone can hinder the acquisition of useful retrieval representations. Semantically related training samples may provide complementary observations, yet existing volume-based objectives jointly align modalities within each sample without explicitly enabling information exchange across samples. We therefore propose a training-time hypergraph fusion framework that connects observed modalities both within samples and across semantically related samples, allowing representation learning to draw on evidence beyond an individual sample while leaving the retrieval pipeline unchanged at inference. The framework includes HyVol as a special case and introduces two configurations: wHyVol learns view contribution weights and symmetric semantic affinities, whereas wRHG additionally models typed interactions and participant roles through relational propagation. Missing modalities are omitted rather than imputed, and the hypergraph is discarded after training, incurring no additional inference cost. Experiments on eleven zero-shot video-text and audio-text retrieval benchmarks demonstrate broad improvements with both GRAM and HyperGRAM. Across 17 video benchmark-modality settings evaluated in both retrieval directions, wRHG outperforms GRAM in all 34 comparisons and HyperGRAM in 33 of 34. Mean text-to-video R@1 increases from 63.4 to 68.2 with GRAM and from 64.8 to 68.4 with HyperGRAM, while the largest video-to-text gain reaches 13.3 percentage points on ActivityNet. Under missing-modality evaluation, both weighted configurations retain positive text-to-video gains over GRAM across seven benchmarks at every evaluated missingness rate, even when 90% of clips lack one modality.
blocks.zh: 多式联运检索必须综合来自可能缺失、吵闹或信息不均的观点的补充证据。 当样本提供有限的可靠证据时,仅仅从其观点中学习会妨碍获取有用的检索说明. 与语义相关的培训样本可提供补充观测,但现有的量基目标在未明确允许在样本之间交流信息的情况下,在每个样本中联合调整模式。 因此,我们提出一个培训时间超图聚变框架,将样本内部和与标本有关的观察模式联系起来,使代表学习能够吸取单个样本之外的证据,同时使检索管道保持不变,从而推论。 该框架将HyVol作为一个特例,并引入了两种配置:wHyVol学习查看贡献权重和对称语义亲和,而wRHG额外模型通过关系传播输入了互动和参与者角色. 缺失的模式被省略,而不是推算,在培训后,高频图被丢弃,不产生额外的推论费用. 关于11个零镜头视频文本和音频文本检索基准的实验显示,GRAM和HyperGRAM都有了广泛的改进。 在两个检索方向评价的17个视频基准模式设置中,WRHG在所有34个比较中都超过了GRAM,在34个比较中有33个超过了HyperGRAM。 平均文本到视频R@1从GRAM的63.4增加到68.2,HyperGRAM的64.8增加到68.4,而最大的视频到文本收益在ActiveNet上达到13.3个百分点. 在缺失模式评价中,两个加权配置在7个基准中保留了文字对视频的正面收益,每个评估的缺失率,即使90%的剪辑缺乏一种模式。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of the proposed framework. (a) Existing methods score each clip alone: a clip’s score depends only on the caption and the clip’s own views, and every other clip in the batch, even a related one, is pushed apart as a negative. (b) Our training-time hypergraph: observed views form vertices, document hyperedges group the views of each clip, and caption-guided semantic hyperedges connect related clips through same-modality and cross-modality links; missing views have no vertex and are not imputed, and each vertex receives a learned reliability weight. (c) At test time the hypergraph is removed: each clip is encoded and scored independently with the original backbone score, so the inference cost equals that of the backbone.
blocks.zh: 图1:拟议框架概览。 (a) 现行方法只给每个片段打分:片段的分数只取决于标题和片段本身的看法,而批次中的所有其他片段,即使是相干片段,都被打成负分。 (b) 我们的训练时间超时图:观测到的视图形成顶点,文档超时段组合每个片段的视图,字幕指导的语义超时段通过同模式和跨模式链接连接相关片段;缺失的视图没有顶点,没有被推算出来,每个顶点获得一个学习到的可靠性分量. (c) 在测试时去除高频图:每个片段被编码并用原主干分数独立得分,因此推论成本等于主干分.

blocks.en: Humans interpret the world by integrating information across multiple sensory modalities. For example, visual input can influence auditory perception, while language provides contextual cues that help unify sensory experiences. Psychologists refer to this process as multisensory integration, through which individuals reconstruct events from both overlapping and modality-specific sensory cues. Multimodal representation learning presents an analogous challenge because images, sounds, speech, and text capture complementary aspects of the same scenario. Effective representation learning must therefore identify shared features across modalities while preserving the distinctive information provided by each modality.
blocks.zh: 人类通过综合多种感官模式的信息来解释世界. 例如,视觉输入可以影响听觉感知,而语言则提供上下文提示来帮助统一感知体验. 心理学家将这一过程称为多感融合,个人通过这一过程从重叠和特定模式的感官提示来重建事件. 由于图像、声音、语音和文本都包含同一情景的互补方面,多式联运的学习提出了类似的挑战。 因此,有效的代表性学习必须确定不同模式的共同特征,同时保留每种模式提供的独特信息。

blocks.en: Text-to-video retrieval requires a model to identify, among thousands of clips, the clip described by a given caption. Each clip provides multiple views of the same event, including frames, a soundtrack, and subtitles, but real-world collections rarely contain all views at consistently high quality. Consider two clips described as “a man explains how to tune a guitar”. In the first clip, the frames depict the guitar, and the subtitles transcribe the explanation. In the second, the subtitles are absent, and the soundtrack contains only background music, leaving the frames as the sole reliable source of evidence. Such missing, noisy, and unequally informative views are common, requiring a retrieval model to integrate them into a single relevance score.
blocks.zh: 文本到视频检索需要一个模型,在上千个剪辑中,识别由给定字幕描述的剪辑. 每个片段提供同一事件的多处取景,包括帧,音轨,字幕等,但现实世界的藏品很少包含始终保持高品质的所有取景. 将两段描述为“一个人解释如何调吉他”。 在第一个片段中,帧描绘了吉他,而字幕则转录了解释. 在第二作中,字幕没有出现,而音轨只收录了背景音乐,让帧成为唯一可靠的证据来源. 这种缺失、吵闹和资料不全的观点是常见的,需要一种检索模式来将它们纳入一个单一的相关评分。

blocks.en: Current multimodal retrieval models evaluate each clip independently. Contrastive foundation models such as CLIP [ 31 ] measure the cosine similarity between two embeddings, while their multi-view extensions either align each view with an anchor modality or fuse multiple views into a single representation [ 13 , 50 , 5 , 24 ] . Geometric objectives extend this approach by jointly scoring all views of a clip using the volume spanned with the caption in Gram [ 8 ] , the area of a triangle in TRIANGLE [ 7 ] , the dominant singular value in PMRL [ 25 ] , or a combination of Euclidean and hyperbolic volumes in HyperGram [ 28 ] . Nevertheless, in all these methods, a clip’s score depends exclusively on the caption and the clip’s own views. Consequently, in the example above, the second clip must be matched using only one reliable view, while the first clip, despite depicting the same event, is treated solely as a negative during training [ 27 , 26 ] .
blocks.zh: 当前多模式检索模型对每个剪辑进行独立评价. CLIP[31]等相矛盾的基础模型测量出两个嵌入物之间的同位素相似性,而其多视图扩展则要么将每个视图与锚地模式相配合,要么将多个视图连接成一个单一代表 [13,50,5,24]. 几何目标扩展了这一方法,方法是使用Gram [8] 、TRIANGLE三角形区域、PMRL [25] 中的主要单值、或HyperGram中欧几利得和双曲卷的组合,对片段的所有视图进行联合评分。 不过,在所有这些方法中,剪辑的分数完全取决于标题和剪辑本身的看法。 因此,在上述例子中,第二个片段必须只使用一个可靠的视图进行配对,而第一个片段尽管描绘了同一事件,但在训练期间却只作为负数处理[27、26]。

blocks.en: Our central premise is that fusion should exploit complementary evidence both within a sample and across semantically related training samples. When a clip contains missing or uninformative views, restricting fusion to its own observations limits the evidence available for representation learning. Related clips may contain useful observations of similar events, providing an additional source of supervision through information exchange. This motivates a fusion mechanism that jointly models cross-modal dependencies within clips and semantic associations across clips.
blocks.zh: 我们的中心前提是,核聚变应利用在样本中和在与母体有关的培训样本中的补充证据。 当片段包含缺失或非信息化观点时,将聚变限制在自己的观察中,限制了可供代表学习的证据. 相关片段可能包含对类似事件的有益观察,通过信息交流提供了额外的监督来源. 这激励了一个聚变机制,联合模拟剪辑内部的跨模式依赖关系和跨剪辑的语义关联.

blocks.en: We propose a training-time hypergraph feature fusion framework that captures both forms of interaction. Each observed candidate modality forms a vertex, while hyperedges connect modalities belonging to the same candidate and observations from semantically related candidates. Feature propagation along these hyperedges integrates contextual evidence into the modality-specific representations, which remain separate inputs to the retrieval objective. Learned contribution weights regulate this fusion, while relational propagation distinguishes interaction types and participant roles. Missing views remain absent rather than being reconstructed. The hypergraph operates only during training, allowing the encoders to learn from fused evidence while preserving independent candidate encoding and the original retrieval procedure at inference. Figure 1 contrasts this design with existing methods, which score each clip alone, and shows that the hypergraph is removed at test time.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个培训时间的超时图特征聚变框架,它能够捕捉两种形式的相互作用。 观察到的每一种候选人模式都形成顶点,而超接点则将属于同一候选人的模式和与候选人密切相关的候选人的意见联系起来。 沿着这些高地缘的地貌传播将背景证据纳入特定模式的表述,这仍然是对检索目标的单独投入。 所学贡献权重调节了这种组合,而关系传播则区分了互动类型和参与者角色. 所缺乏的观点仍然缺乏,而不是被重建。 高频图只在训练期间运行,使编码者能够从被熔化的证据中学习,同时在推断时保留独立的候选编码和原始检索程序. 图1对比了这种设计与现有方法,这些方法只得分每个片段,并显示高分图在测试时被去除.

blocks.en: Our framework differs from conventional fusion strategies in three respects. First, it integrates evidence both within individual clips and across semantically related training clips. Second, unlike approaches that reconstruct missing views [ 27 ] , it operates only on observed modalities, enabling information exchange without imputation. Third, fusion is confined to training: the learned encoders retain their benefits, while inference requires neither a hypergraph nor interactions among evaluation candidates. The framework encompasses HyVol [ 29 ] as a special case, where document and semantic neighborhood hyperedges support additive feature fusion. Our weighted and relational configurations investigate how to regulate individual-view contributions and related-sample contributions, and how different interactions should participate in the fusion.
blocks.zh: 我们的框架在三个方面不同于常规聚变战略。 首先,它把证据综合到个别剪辑中,并跨出与精密相关的培训剪辑。 第二,它与重建缺失观点的方法不同[27],它只根据观测到的模式运作,能够进行信息交流而无需估算。 第三,聚变仅限于培训:学习的编码者保留他们的好处,而推论既不需要高频图,也不需要评价候选人之间的互动。 该框架将HyVol[29]作为一个特例,其中文件和语义学相邻的超接物支持添加剂特性聚变. 我们的加权和关系配置研究了如何规范个人观点贡献和相关实例贡献,以及不同互动应如何参与聚变.

blocks.en: HyVol does not explicitly model differences in view reliability or distinguish modality-specific interaction types. A silent soundtrack receives the same weight as the frames of the corresponding clip; related clips are weighted by an attention score that ranks the neighbors of every clip in the same order [ 2 ] ; and a link between the frames of two clips is not distinguished from a link between the frames of one clip and the subtitles of another. Moreover, only the refined embeddings are trained, although retrieval subsequently uses the unrefined embeddings. Information exchange across clips therefore raises two questions that remain unresolved in HyVol: how much should each view and each related clip contribute, and what type of relationship connects them?
blocks.zh: HyVol没有明确在视图可靠性上模拟差异,也没有区分特定模式的相互作用类型. 一个无声的音轨得到的分量与对应片段的帧相同;相關片段由注意分来加权,将每个片段的相邻者按同顺序排列为[2];而两个片段的帧之间的链接与一个片段的帧和另一个片段的字幕之间的链接没有区别. 此外,只有被精制的嵌入器经过了训练,尽管回取器后来使用了未精制的嵌入器. 因此,不同片段之间的信息交流提出了HyVol中尚未解决的两个问题:每个视图和每个相关片段应贡献多少,哪些类型的关系将它们联系起来?

blocks.en: Weighted HyVol (wHyVol) addresses the first question through two learned weights. The first is a view-specific reliability weight predicted solely from the corresponding view embedding. In the guitar example, the background music in the second clip may receive a low weight, while its frames receive a high weight, causing the clip representation to be determined primarily by reliable evidence. The reliability weight therefore provides an adaptive fusion mechanism for imbalanced views: each view’s contribution depends on its estimated quality rather than its modality. The second weight represents the affinity between two related clips; it is computed jointly from their captions and is symmetric. Consequently, a clip receives substantial information from a close semantic match but little information from a weak or incidental match. Unlike the attention mechanism in HyVol, this affinity can induce different neighbour rankings for different clips.
blocks.zh: 加权的HyVol(wHyVol)通过两个学习的权重解决了第一个问题. 第一个是仅从相应的嵌入视图中预言的视向特定可靠性重量. 在吉他的例子中,第二段片段中的背景音乐可能获得较低的分量,而其帧则获得较高的分量,导致片段表现主要由可靠的证据决定. 因此,可靠性权重为不平衡观点提供了一个适应性聚变机制:每一种观点的贡献取决于其估计质量,而不是其模式。 第二个权重代表两个相关片段之间的相近性;它由两个片段的标题共同计算,是对称的. 因此,片段从近语义匹配获得大量信息,而从弱小或偶然匹配获得的信息却很少. 与"HyVol"中的关注机制不同,这种亲和性可以诱导不同的相邻排行不同的剪辑.

blocks.en: The weighted relational hypergraph (wRHG) addresses the second question. It retains both weights introduced by wHyVol but replaces untyped links with typed relations. A same-modality link connects corresponding views from two related clips, such as their frames; a cross-modality link connects different views, such as the frames of one clip and the subtitles of another; and a whole-clip link connects all observed views from both clips. Each relation type has distinct learned parameters, and the message received by a view through a link depends jointly on all other views associated with that link. Thus, a clip with missing subtitles can learn from a related clip’s subtitles through a cross-modality link, while the model learns the relative importance of each relation type.
blocks.zh: 加权关系高分图(wRHG)解决了第二个问题. 它保留了由wHyVol引入的两种权重,但以打字关系取代了未打字的链接. 同模式链接连接两个相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相有相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相相關相相關相相相相關相相關相關相關相相關相相關相關相關相相關相相關相相相關相相關相關相相相相關相關相關相 每种关系类型都有不同的已学习到的参数,一个观点通过链接收到的信息共同取决于与该链接相关的所有其他观点. 因此,缺少字幕的片段可以通过跨模式链接从相关片段的字幕中学习,而模型则学习出每种关系类型的相对重要性.

blocks.en: In wHyVol and wRHG , a missing view has no corresponding vertex in the hypergraph; consequently, neither model imputes nor replaces missing views. These configurations also train the unrefined embeddings used at test time. As with HyVol , their hypergraph modules operate exclusively during training. We integrate HyVol , wHyVol , and wRHG with two volume-based backbones, Gram and HyperGram , which share the pretrained vision–audio–language foundation encoders (VAST [ 5 ] ). We evaluate all configurations zero-shot on eleven text–video and text–audio retrieval benchmarks. Averaged across the 17 17 text-to-video settings from the eight video benchmarks, the R@1 of Gram increases from 63.4 63.4 to 68.2 68.2 with wRHG (and to 67.3 67.3 with HyVol ), while that of HyperGram increases from 64.8 64.8 to 68.4 68.4 . The gains are consistent across datasets: wRHG improves the R@1 of Gram in all 17 17 text-to-video and all 17 17 video-to-text settings, and improves that of HyperGram in 16 16 and 17 17 settings, respectively. The weighted variants also retain gains under missing-modality evaluation, with consistent improvements over GRAM and benchmark-dependent results with HyperGram . Our main contributions are as follows. • We formulate multi-view feature fusion within and across semantically related samples through a common training-time hypergraph framework, with HyVol recovered as a special case. • We introduce two new instances of this framework: a weighted hypergraph ( wHyVol ), which learns the contribution of each view and related clip, and a weighted relational hypergraph ( wRHG ), which models distinct interaction types through relation-specific parameters and participant roles. Both methods handle missing views without imputation and incur no additional inference cost. • We evaluate the proposed methods using two backbones and eleven zero-shot benchmarks—eight for text–video retrieval and three for text–audio retrieval—and conduct a missing-modality study across seven video benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 在 wHyVol 和 wRHG 中,缺失视图在超图中没有相应的顶点;因此,模型既不对缺失视图进行分解,也不替换. 这些配置还训练了测试时使用的未经改进的嵌入. 与HyVol一样,他们的高频图模块只在培训期间运行。 我们把HyVol、wHyVol和wRHG与两个基于量的骨干(Gram和HyperGram)整合起来,后者具有预先训练的视觉-Audio-语言基础编码器(VAST [5])。 我们评价所有配置在11个文本-视频和文本-音频检索基准上的零镜头。 平均在17个文本到视频设置中,从8个视频基准,Gram的R@1从63.4 63.4增至68.2 68.2 wRHG(从HyVol增至67.3),而HyperGram从64.8 64.8增至68.4 68.4。 不同数据集的收益是一致的:wRHG在全部17个文本到视频和全部17个视频到文本设置中改进了Gram的R@1,并在16个和17个设置中分别改进了HyperGram的R@1. 加权变量还保留了缺失模式评价下的增益,与GRAM相比有连贯一致的改进,与HyperGram相比,取决于基准的结果。 我们的主要贡献如下。 我们通过一个共同的训练时间高分图框架,在与精密相关的样品内部和之间形成多视图特征聚变,HyVol作为特例恢复。 我们提出这个框架的两个新实例:一个是加权超图(wHyVol),它学习了每个视图和相关剪辑的贡献;另一个是加权关系超图(wRHG),它通过关系特定参数和参与者角色模拟不同的相互作用类型。 这两种方法都处理缺失的意见而不进行估算,也不产生额外推论费用。 我们使用两个主干线和11个零镜头基准评估拟议方法——8个用于文本视频检索,3个用于文本视频检索——并进行7个视频基准的缺失模式研究。

Both methods handle missing views without imputation and incur no additional inference cost.

blocks.en: Building on HyVol [ 29 ] , this article introduces a general framework together with wHyVol and wRHG, expands the evaluation from six to eleven benchmarks, and extends the missing-modality study from four to seven video benchmarks. The remainder of this article is organized as follows. Section 2 reviews the related literature. Section 3 presents the general hypergraph framework, recovers HyVol as a special case, and introduces wHyVol and wRHG. Section 4 describes the datasets and evaluation protocol and reports the zero-shot and missing-modality results. Section 5 discusses these results, Section 6 outlines the limitations of the approach, and Section 7 concludes the article.
blocks.zh: 在HyVol [29]的基础上,本条引入了一个与wHyVol和wRHG一起的总体框架,将评价从6个基准扩大到11个基准,并将缺失模式研究从4个视频基准扩大到7个视频基准。 本条其余部分按下列方式编排. 第2节审查有关文献。 第3节介绍了一般的超图框架,将HyVol作为特例予以恢复,并引入了wHyVol和wRHG. 第4节描述了数据集和评价协议,并报告了零射出和缺失模式的结果。 第5节讨论这些结果,第6节概述方法的局限性,第7节结束这一条。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Our research builds upon multimodal representation learning, higher-order geometric alignment, and hypergraph-based information fusion. We examine these foundational concepts alongside methods that address missing and imbalanced modalities, inter-sample structural relationships in retrieval tasks, and relation-aware message passing.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究以多模式表述学习、高等几何校正和高分法信息聚合为基础。 我们研究这些基础概念,同时研究处理缺失和不平衡模式的方法、检索任务中的抽样结构关系以及了解关系的信息传递。

blocks.en: 2.1 Contrastive Vision–Language and Multimodal Foundations
blocks.zh: 2.1 矛盾愿景-语言和多式联运基础

blocks.en:
CLIP [ 31 ] established contrastive pretraining on image–text pairs, whereby representations of matched pairs are brought closer together while all other pairs in the batch serve as negatives. Subsequent work developed larger and openly available backbones [ 33 ] .
More recent approaches have developed large-scale video–language models pretrained on extensive video corpora [ 46 , 44 , 38 , 39 , 35 , 47 ] .
Contrastive learning has also been applied to audio–text retrieval [ 30 , 48 ] and to text–video retrieval through multigranular alignment and text-conditioned objectives.
blocks.zh:
CLIP [31] 在图像-文本配对上确立了对比性预训,使配对配对的表示更加接近,而批次中的其他配对则成为负数. 随后的工作发展出更大的,可公开获取的骨干[33].
较新的方法已开发出大规模视频-语言模型,预先在广泛的视频公司上培训[46、44、38、39、35、47]。
对音频-文本检索[30,48]和文本-视频检索也采用了相矛盾的学习方法,这些方法通过多角度对齐和文字条件化的目标。

blocks.en: When more than two modalities are available, existing methods typically either fuse streams into a single representation or align them within a shared embedding space. VALOR [ 24 ] fuses video and audio, while VAST [ 5 ] additionally incorporates subtitles. ImageBind [ 13 ] and LanguageBind [ 50 ] instead align modalities using images and language as anchors, respectively. Alignment may also precede explicit cross-modal fusion [ 20 ] . These approaches do not directly score joint agreement among a candidate’s individual streams. Our models retain the modality-specific VAST embeddings and evaluate their joint agreement with the query.
blocks.zh: 当存在两种以上模式时,现有方法通常要么将引信串通成单一的表示,要么在共享嵌入空间内加以调整。 VALOR [24] 装入了视频和音频,而VAST [5] 增加了字幕。 ImageBind [13]和LanguageBind [50] 转而分别以图像和语言为锚点来对接模式. 统一也可在明确的跨模式组合[20]之前进行。 这些办法没有直接在候选人的个别流中取得共同协议。 我们的模型保留了特定模式的VAST嵌入并评价它们与查询的联合协议.

blocks.en: 2.2 Higher-Order Geometric Alignment
blocks.zh: 2.2 高序几何对齐

blocks.en: Recent methods assess multimodal agreement through joint geometric objectives. GRAM [ 8 ] uses the Gramian volume spanned by the query and candidate modality embeddings, while Triangle [ 7 ] measures the triangle area formed by text, video, and audio embeddings. PMRL [ 25 ] promotes rank-one alignment by maximising the dominant singular value of the embedding matrix, and HyperGram [ 28 ] combines Euclidean and hyperbolic volumes. These methods score each candidate using only its own embeddings. HyVol [ 29 ] introduces information exchange across candidates through a training-time hypergraph while retaining the Gram and HyperGram scoring functions. Our framework includes HyVol as a special case and investigates learned contribution weights, semantic affinities, and typed relational propagation.
blocks.zh: 最近的方法通过联合几何目标来评估多式联运协议。 GRAM [8] 使用由查询和候选模式嵌入所覆盖的格莱美体积,而三角 [7] 测量由文本,视频,音频嵌入所形成的三角区域. PMRL [25] 通过将嵌入矩阵的主导单数值最大化来推动一等对齐,而HyperGram [28]结合了Euclidean和双曲量. 这些方法只用自己的嵌入来评分每个候选人. HyVol[29]在保留格拉姆分和超格拉姆分数功能的同时,通过一个培训时间的超时图,引入了候选人之间的信息交流. 我们的框架将HyVol作为一个特例,并调查所学到的贡献权重、语义亲和以及打字关系传播。

blocks.en: 2.3 Learning with Missing and Imbalanced Modalities
blocks.zh: 2.3 与缺失和不平衡模式有关的学习

blocks.en: Real-world collections often contain missing modalities and streams that differ in informativeness. Existing methods address missing views through reconstruction [ 27 ] or fusion mechanisms designed to accommodate absent inputs [ 26 ] . Our framework instead excludes missing modalities from the hypergraph and the Gram matrix, so retrieval depends only on observed streams. Learned vertex weights predicted from individual modality embeddings regulate their contributions during training-time fusion.
blocks.zh: 现实世界的藏品中往往含有缺失的模式和流出的信息性不同. 现有方法通过重建[27]或旨在容纳所缺投入的聚变机制来解决所缺观点[26]. 反之,我们的框架将缺失的模式排除在超文本图和格拉姆矩阵之外,因此检索只取决于观测到的流. 从个别模式嵌入中预测的已学习到的顶点权重可以调节其在培训时间聚变过程中的贡献。

blocks.en: 2.4 Hypergraphs and Inter-Sample Structure in Retrieval
blocks.zh: 2.4 检索中的超图和样本间结构

blocks.en: Hypergraphs represent higher-order relations by connecting multiple vertices within a single hyperedge. Hypergraph neural networks exchange features between vertices and hyperedges [ 11 ] , while AllSet [ 6 ] learns set-based aggregation functions. Applications include cross-modal retrieval through bipartite hypergraphs [ 22 ] . Attention mechanisms learn interaction weights [ 34 ] , although the original additive attention score has a static neighbor-ranking property [ 2 ] , motivating the pair-dependent affinity kernel in wHyVol. In retrieval, inter-item structure is also exploited through test-time methods such as k k -reciprocal re-ranking [ 49 ] and querybank normalisation [ 1 ] . By contrast, HyVol [ 29 ] and our configurations exchange information only during training, allowing independent candidate encoding without additional inference cost.
blocks.zh: Hypergraphs通过将多个顶点连接在一个单一的超接点内来代表高阶关系. Hypergraph神经网络在顶点和超尖点之间交换特征[11],而AllSet [6]则学习了基于设置的聚合函数. 应用包括通过双相多相图进行跨模式检索[22]. 注意机制学习交互权重 [34],虽然最初的添加剂注意分有静态邻位属性 [2],激发了wHyVol中依赖对等亲和内核. 在检索中,还利用了项目间结构,如k k-对等重排[49]和查询银行正常化[1]等测试时间方法。 相形之下,HyVol [29] 和我们的配置仅在训练期间交换信息,允许独立候选人编码而不增加推论费用.

blocks.en: 2.5 Relational and Knowledge Hypergraphs
blocks.zh: 2.5 关系和知识

blocks.en: Relational graph convolutional networks [ 32 ] assign distinct transformations to different edge types. Knowledge hypergraphs extend this principle to facts involving more than two arguments, where the position of each entity carries semantic information. HypE [ 10 ] embeds entities using position-specific filters; StarE [ 12 ] represents hyper-relational facts with qualifiers; and G-MPNN [ 41 ] performs message passing over multi-relational ordered hypergraphs. HC-MPNN [ 17 ] combines relation embeddings with positional encodings and constructs the message to each member of a fact from all remaining members. Its expressive power for link prediction has been characterised for relations of arbitrary arity.
blocks.zh: 相通图回旋网络 [32] 指定不同边缘类型的不同变换. 知识超音速图将这一原则延伸至涉及两个以上论据的事实,每个实体的立场都包含语义信息. HypE [10] 使用特定位置过滤器将实体嵌入; StarE [12] 代表带有限定词的超对接事实;以及 G-MPNN [41] 执行消息传出多对接命令的超对接. HC-MPNN [17] 将关系嵌入与位置编码结合,并构建所有剩余成员给每个成员的一个事实的信息. 它对联系预测的表达力被描述为任意性关系。

blocks.en: Graphs with multiple edge types have also been applied to multimodal fusion. For conversational emotion recognition, MMGCN [ 16 ] connects utterances through modality-specific and cross-modal edges. For unaligned multimodal language sequences, MTAG [ 43 ] constructs a graph whose edges depend on node modalities and temporal order. In each setting, the data determine the edges or facts, such as a knowledge base, conversational order, or temporal order. In wRHG, by contrast, facts are constructed within each training batch according to caption similarity, and each fact’s relation type identifies the modalities and candidates that it connects.
blocks.zh: 多种边缘类型的图也被用于多式聚变。 对于对话情感识别,MMGCN[16]通过模式特异性和跨模式边缘连接了语音. 对于不相通的多式语言序列,MTAG [43] 构造出一个其边缘取决于节点模式和时间顺序的图. 在每个设定中,数据决定了边缘或事实,如知识基础,对话顺序,或时间顺序等. 在 wRHG 中,相反,每个培训批次中的事实都是根据标题相似性构建的,每个事实的关系类型都确定了它连接的方式和候选人.

blocks.en: 3 Relational Hypergraph Learning
blocks.zh: 3 关系超图学习

blocks.en: Multimodal representation learning must capture dependencies at two complementary levels: cross-modal associations within each candidate and semantic correspondences across candidates. The former integrates complementary evidence from the modalities observed for a candidate, while the latter lets its representation incorporate relevant information from semantically related candidates in the same training batch. We model both forms of dependency using a weighted hypergraph in which each vertex represents an observed candidate–modality pair. Hyperedge construction determines which vertices interact, learned weights control their contributions, and the propagation operator specifies how the resulting information is aggregated.
blocks.zh: 多式联运代表性的学习必须在两个相辅相成的层面上抓住依赖:每个候选人内部的跨模式协会和候选人之间的语义通信。 前者综合了对候选人采用的方法中的补充证据,后者则允许其代表将同一批培训中具有血缘关系的候选人提供的相关资料纳入其中。 我们用一个加权高分图模拟两种依赖形式,其中每个顶点代表一个观察到的候选模式对。 超尖构造决定了哪一个顶点相互作用,所学的权重控制了它们的贡献,而传播操作员则指定了由此产生的信息如何相加.

blocks.en: The framework supports two propagation mechanisms: weighted additive aggregation and relation-conditioned multiplicative interaction. Both mechanisms refine candidate embeddings under the original retrieval objective without imposing a specific similarity function or representation geometry. HyVol [ 29 ] is recovered as a special case by choosing a specific hyperedge construction, weighting scheme, and additive propagation operator. The hypergraph is used only during training; at inference, the model retains the trained encoders and follows the original retrieval procedure without constructing or propagating the hypergraph. Figure 2 summarises the framework.
blocks.zh: 该框架支持两种传播机制:加权添加剂聚合和具有关联条件的多活性互动。 这两种机制都在原始检索目标下完善了候选嵌入物,而没有强制规定特定的相似性函数或代表几何. HyVol [29]作为特殊情况予以回收,办法是选择一个特定的超尖端构造、加权法和添加剂传播操作员。 高频图只在训练期间使用;推断模型保留了所训练的编码器并遵循原始的检索程序而无需构建或宣传高频图. 图2概述了框架。

blocks.en: The weighted configuration uses the neighbourhood hyperedges in Eq. ( 4 ) and additive propagation in Eq. ( 5 ). Learned vertex weights regulate within-candidate contributions, while the symmetric exponential kernel in Eq. ( 2 ) regulates cross-candidate connections. Unlike HyVol ’s original attention rule, these connection weights are not obtained through a neighborhood softmax.
blocks.zh: 加权配置采用Eq. (4)和Eq. (5)中的相邻高缘和添加剂传播。 所学的顶点权重调节了指定范围内的贡献,而Eq. (2)中的对称指数内核则调节了跨指定连接. 与HyVol最初的注意规则不同,这些连接权重不是通过相邻软max获得的.

blocks.en: The relational configuration uses four typed hyperedge families. Within a single candidate, the document hyperedge connects all observed modalities of that candidate; since it already contains every pair of these modalities (e.g., video with audio), separate modality-pair hyperedges are not required. Between two related candidates i i and j j , i.e., candidates whose captions are mutual top- k k neighbours, three families are used: same-modality hyperedges connect matching modalities (e.g., video of i i with video of j j ), cross-modality hyperedges connect different modalities (e.g., video of i i with audio of j j ), and the joint-candidate hyperedge contains all observed modalities of both candidates. Messages over these hyperedges are formed multiplicatively by Eq. ( 6 ), and vertex features are updated by Eq. ( 7 ). Each family has its own relation embedding, and each participating modality has its own role embedding, so the model distinguishes, for example, a video–video same-modality interaction from a video–audio cross-modality interaction, which additive propagation would combine through the same transformation.
blocks.zh: 关系配置使用四个打入的超对接家族. 在一个候选人中,文件超接力连接该候选人的所有观察到的模式;由于文件已经包含每对这些模式(例如带音频的视频),因此不需要单独的模式-pair超接力。 在两个相关的候选人i和jj之间,即标题是共同上-k-相邻的候选人,使用三个家族:同型超缘连接匹配模式(例如i的视频与jj的视频相接),跨型超缘连接不同模式(例如i的视频与jj的音频相接),而联合Candidate超缘包含两个候选人所观察到的所有模式. 这些超边缘上的信息由Eq. (6)多相形成,顶点特征由Eq. (7.)更新. 每个家庭都有自己的关系嵌入,每个参与模式都有自己的角色嵌入,因此模型区分了视频-视频同模式交互和视频-视频-视频同模式交互,通过同样的转化,添加剂的传播将结合起来。

blocks.en: These configurations are instances of the common propagation formulation rather than successive restrictions of a single multiplicative operator. HyVol is recovered by selecting its complete structural and computational specification. Restricting relation families alone changes the available interactions but does not convert multiplicative propagation into HyVol ’s additive aggregation.
blocks.zh: 这些配置是常见的传播配方,而不是连续限制单一多管操作员。 HyVol通过选择其完整的结构和计算规格来回收. 限制关系家庭本身就改变现有的相互作用,但不会将多活性传播转化为HyVol的添加剂聚合。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: We evaluate whether training-time hypergraph fusion improves multimodal retrieval across different backbones, benchmarks, and modality configurations. Our experiments assess zero-shot retrieval performance and robustness to missing modalities, comparing HyVol , wHyVol , and wRHG with their corresponding backbones and existing retrieval methods. We first describe the datasets and experimental protocol, then present and analyze the results.
blocks.zh: 我们评价培训时间的超文本集成是否改善了不同骨干、基准和模式配置的多式检索。 我们的实验评估了零发回取性能和强性到缺失模式,将HyVol,wHyVol,和wRHG与其对应的骨干和现有的回取方法进行比较. 我们首先描述数据集和实验协议,然后介绍和分析结果。

blocks.en: 4.1.1 Training data
blocks.zh: 4.1.1 培训数据

blocks.en: All models trained in this work are initialized from the VAST checkpoint [ 5 ] and trained on the 150 150 K-clip subset of VAST - 27 27 M used by Gram [ 8 ] and HyperGram [ 28 ] . Each clip has five visual captions and audio captions, a subtitle containing the speech transcript, and one omni-modal caption that integrates visual, acoustic, and speech information. We use the omni-modal caption as the training text to provide supervision that captures complementary information across the candidate modalities. The annotation file for the subset lists 150,154 150,154 clips, of which 136,694 136,694 were successfully recovered with both video and audio because online video availability changed. These recovered clips constitute the effective training corpus for all models trained in this work.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中接受过培训的所有模型均从VAST检查站[5]初始化,并培训了Gram[8]和HyperGram[28]使用的150个K-clip子集。 每个片段有五个视觉字幕和音频字幕,一个包含语音记录的字幕,以及一个集视觉、声学和语音信息为一体的全方位模式字幕。 我们使用全方位模式的标题作为培训文本,以提供监督,收集各种候选模式的补充信息。 子集的注释文件列出了150,154,150,154个片段,其中136,694,136,694个片段由于在线视频的提供情况发生变化,通过视频和音频都成功恢复. 这些回收的剪辑是所有在这项工作中接受培训的模型的有效培训工具。

blocks.en: For Gram [ 8 ] , Triangle [ 7 ] , and PMRL [ 25 ] , we evaluated the checkpoints released by their authors. The exact set of clips available during the original training of these checkpoints cannot be reconstructed. We therefore distinguish comparisons against released checkpoints from comparisons between models trained on our common accessible subset.
blocks.zh: 对于格拉姆[8],三角[7],以及PMRL[25],我们评价了他们的作者释放的检查站. 这些检查站最初训练期间的准确片段无法重建。 因此,我们将与已放行的检查站进行比较,与就我们共同无障碍子集培训的模式进行比较。

blocks.en: Table 1 summarises the eleven evaluation benchmarks: eight for video–text retrieval and three for audio–text retrieval. These benchmarks differ in their temporal structure, annotation granularity, and available modalities, enabling evaluation across short videos, multi-shot narratives, long-video excerpts, and sound recordings. We do not use any target benchmarks for training in this work, and we perform all evaluations without target-specific adaptation. When several alternative captions describe an item, we select the first caption in the annotation file. DiDeMo and ActivityNet instead use paragraph queries constructed from the sentences associated with each video, as detailed below. All methods we evaluate use the same queries and candidate collections.

Retrieval is evaluated in both directions: text-to-video and video-to-text on the video benchmarks, and text-to-audio and audio-to-text on the audio benchmarks. blocks.zh: 表1:评价基准统计:TT、VV、A和S表示文字、视频、音频和字幕。 模式列出了与文本相比的模式,主要模式首先是:视频基准上的T-V、T-VA和T-VAS,音频基准上的T-A和T-AV。 对检索的评价分为两个方向:视频基准上的文本到视频和视频到文本,音频基准上的文本到音频和音频到文本. 文本查询是文本一侧使用的注释. 列车和Val给出了分数大小;我们不使用它们,因为所有的评价都是零镜头. 测试是被评价项目的数量. 帧是视频帧的数量,Audio是每个片段抽样的10个音段的数量. 最大标题长度是每个查询所保存的文本符的最大数量;较长的查询被截取.

blocks.en: Shot2Story-20K [ 14 ] contains multi-shot videos paired with summary descriptions. Its 4,023-video test split allows us to examine retrieval when a query describes content distributed across several shots. MSVD [ 4 ] contains short videos with multiple textual descriptions, and we evaluate its 670-video test split. Since audio is unavailable in our MSVD evaluation data, only the T–V setting is reported.
blocks.zh: Shhot2Story-20K [14] 包含多镜头视频配对,并附有摘要描述. 它的4,023-video测试拆分让我们在查询描述分布在多个镜头中的内容时检查检索. MSVD [4] 包含多个文字描述的短视频,我们评价其670-视频测试分拆. 由于我们的MSVD评价数据中没有音频,所以只报告T-V设置.

blocks.en: FLARE [ 45 ] provides clips extracted from longer videos, together with vision, audio, and unified audiovisual captions. We evaluate a fixed subset of 5,000 clips, using vision captions for T–V and unified captions for T–VA. These settings differ in both query content and candidate modalities; therefore, their performance differences do not isolate the contribution of audio.
blocks.zh: FLARE [45] 提供从更长的视频中提取的片段,以及视觉、音频和统一的视听字幕。 我们用T-V的视觉字幕和T-VA的统一字幕来评估一个固定的分集,共5000个剪辑。 这些设置在查询内容和候选模式上都不同;因此,它们的性能差异并不孤立音频的贡献.

blocks.en: VALOR-32K [ 24 ] consists of approximately 10 s clips accompanied by captions describing both visible content and audible events. We evaluate its 3,491-item test split. Its audiovisual annotations complement benchmarks whose descriptions primarily emphasize visual content.
blocks.zh: VALOR-32K [24] 由大约10个片段组成,并附有描述可见内容和可听取事件的字幕. 我们评估了它的3 491个测试项目。 其视听说明是对基准的补充,其说明主要强调视觉内容。

blocks.en: AudioCaps [ 18 ] pairs audio events with natural-language descriptions. We use the same 700-item test split as VAST [ 5 ] and Gram [ 8 ] . The corresponding video is available alongside the audio, allowing evaluation in the T–AV setting.
blocks.zh: AudioCaps [18] 配对有自然语言描述的音频事件. 我们使用与VAST [5] 和Gram [8] 相同的700项测试分数. 相应的视频与音频同时提供,允许在T-AV环境中进行评价.

blocks.en: Clotho v2.1 [ 9 ] contains audio recordings with five captions per recording. We evaluate its 1,045-item evaluation split using the first caption associated with each recording. SoundDescs [ 19 ] contains sound-effect recordings paired with textual descriptions, and we evaluate on 4,947 test items. Both Clotho and SoundDescs are evaluated in the T–A setting, assessing retrieval from acoustic information alone.
blocks.zh: Clotho v2.1 [9] 包含录音,每个录音有5个字幕. 我们使用与每次录制有关的第一个标题来评价其1 045项评价。 SoundDescs [19] 包含声效录音,配以文字描述,我们评价4,947个测试项目. Clotho和SoundDescs均在T-A环境下进行评估,仅评估从声学信息的检索。

blocks.en: 4.2 Compared Methods and Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.2 比较方法和执行细节

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Compared methods
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 国家 比较方法

blocks.en: We evaluate the proposed refinement framework with two retrieval backbones, Gram 1 1 1 https://github.com/ispamm/GRAM [ 8 ] and HyperGram 2 2 2 https://github.com/uta-smile/hypergram [ 28 ] . Gram measures multimodal compatibility through Gramian volumes, whereas HyperGram combines Euclidean and hyperbolic volume-based representations. Evaluating both backbones allows us to examine whether the benefits of hypergraph refinement persist across these two geometric scoring formulations. In each case, the refinement module operates on the candidate representations during training while retaining the backbone’s retrieval scoring function.
blocks.zh: 我们利用两个检索主干网,即Gram 1 1 1 https://github.com/ispamm/GRAM来评价拟议的改进框架。 [8]和HyperGram 2 2 2 https://github.com/uta-smile/hypergram [28]. gram通过Gramian音量测量多式相容性,而HyperGram则结合了Euclidean和双曲音量的表示. 评估这两个主干线,使我们能够审查在这两种几何分数配方中是否仍然存在着高分法改进的好处。 在每一种情况下,改进单元都是在培训期间对候选人的陈述进行操作,同时保留骨干检索评分功能。

blocks.en: For each backbone, we compare the model without hypergraph refinement against three configurations: HyVol 3 3 3 https://github.com/CVML-CFU/HyVol [ 29 ] , the weighted hypergraph configuration wHyVol , and the weighted relational configuration wRHG . HyVol provides the reference configuration with within-candidate and caption-guided semantic hyperedges. The wHyVol configuration introduces learned vertex contributions and symmetric semantic affinity weights within additive propagation. The wRHG configuration additionally distinguishes relation types and participant roles through relational propagation. These comparisons evaluate the full configurations; Section 4.3.4 also examines the hypergraph’s sensitivity to neighborhood size k k .
blocks.zh: 对于每个主干线,我们比较了没有高超图改进的模型与三个配置:HyVol 3 3 https://github.com/CVML-CFU/HyVol [29],加权高超图配置wHyVol,加权关系配置wRHG. HyVol为参考配置提供了指定内和字幕制导的语义超对接. wHyVol配置引入了所学的顶点贡献和添加剂传播中的对称语义亲和权重. wRHG配置通过关系传播,进一步区分了关系类型和参与者角色. 这些比较评估了完整的配置; 第4.3.4节还研究了高分图对相邻大小kk的敏感性.

blocks.en: We additionally compare against Triangle 4 4 4 https://github.com/ispamm/TRIANGLE/ [ 7 ] and PMRL 5 5 5 https://github.com/Xiaohao-Liu/PMRL [ 25 ] . Triangle offers an alternative volume-based retrieval approach using triangular area, while PMRL provides an additional multimodal representation-learning baseline. We include results from other published retrieval systems to contextualize performance within the broader literature.
blocks.zh: 我们与三角4 4 4 4 https://github.com/ispamm/TRIANGLE/ [7]和PMRL 5 5 5 https://github.com/Xiaoho-Liu/PMRL [25]. 三角利用三角区域提供了另一种基于量的检索方法,而PMRL则提供了另一种多式代表性学习基线。 我们列入其他已公布检索系统的成果,以根据具体情况在更广泛的文献中说明业绩。

blocks.en: 4.2.2 Comparison protocol
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 比较协议

blocks.en: We distinguish between methods evaluated using released checkpoints, methods trained in this work, and results taken from prior publications. For Gram , Triangle , and PMRL , we use the checkpoints released by their authors. Since a pretrained HyperGram checkpoint is unavailable, we train HyperGram using the authors’ public implementation and training recipe. All models trained in this work start from the VAST initialization and use the effective training corpus described in Section 4.1.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们区分使用已放行的检查站评估的方法、在这项工作中接受培训的方法以及以往出版物的结果。 我们使用作者释放的检查站, 由于没有经过预先训练的超奶奶检查站,我们利用作者的公开执行和培训方法来训练超奶奶。 在这项工作中接受过培训的所有模式都从《职业教育和培训法》初始化开始,并使用第4.1.1节所述的有效培训工具。

blocks.en: All checkpoints evaluated by us are tested on the same benchmark items and query annotations within each retrieval setting. We evaluate Gram using its retrieval protocol, and we use Triangle ’s released evaluation code. Any method-specific scoring or post-processing is retained and must therefore be considered when interpreting comparisons across methods.
blocks.zh: 我们评价的所有检查站在每一个检索设置中都根据相同的基准项目和查询说明进行测试。 我们使用Gram的检索协议来评价Gram, 保留任何特定方法的评分或后处理,因此在解释各种方法的比较时必须加以考虑。

blocks.en: The common evaluation data remove differences arising from query selection and candidate availability. However, the released checkpoints may differ from models trained in this work in their effective training samples and optimization history. Comparisons against these checkpoints therefore measure performance relative to the available reference systems, rather than isolating the effect of a single architectural component.
blocks.zh: 共同评价数据消除了因查询选择和候选人可用性而产生的差异。 然而,释放的检查站在有效培训样本和优化历史方面可能不同于在这项工作中接受过培训的模式。 因此,与这些检查站的比较衡量的是相对于现有参考系统的业绩,而不是孤立单一建筑部分的效果。

blocks.en: We report published scores separately as reference results because their evaluation collections, input processing, or training conditions may differ from ours. This distinction is particularly relevant for benchmarks affected by video availability, including the reduced VATEX test subset.
blocks.zh: 我们单独报告公布的分数作为参考结果,因为他们的评价收集、投入处理或培训条件可能不同于我们。 这种区别对受视频提供影响的基准特别相关,包括VATEX测试子集的减少.

blocks.en: 4.2.3 Input processing and model configuration
blocks.zh: 4.2.3 (中文(简体) ). 输入处理和模型配置

blocks.en: All compared models share the modality encoders of VAST [ 5 ] : EVA-CLIP ViT-g/14 6 6 6 https://huggingface.co/QuanSun/EVA-CLIP for video frames, BEATs 7 7 7 https://github.com/microsoft/unilm/tree/master/beats for audio, and BERT-base 8 8 8 https://huggingface.co/google-bert/bert-base-uncased for both captions and subtitles. We remove the VAST fusion layers, project each stream to a 512 512 -dimensional space, and ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalize it so that the backbone score acts directly on the per-modality embeddings. The backbone temperature is loaded from its checkpoint and kept trainable.
blocks.zh: 所有比较模型都共享VAST [5]: EVA-CLIP VIT-g/14 6 6 https://huggingface.co/QuanSun/EVA-CLIP的模式编码器. BEATs 7 7 7 https://github.com/microsoft/unilm/tree/master/beats 用于音频,BERT-base 8 8 8 https://huggingface.co/google-bert/bert-base-uncased用于字幕和字幕。 我们移除 VAST 聚变层, 投射每个流 到512 512 - 维空间,和l 2\ell\\2} - 正常化它, 这样骨干分数 直接作用 在每模式嵌入。 骨干温度从检查站加载,并保持可训练。

blocks.en: HyVol , wHyVol and wRHG share the same optimization and data settings on both backbones. Starting from the VAST checkpoint, we train each model for one epoch (533 steps) on the recovered training corpus with a global batch of 256 clips, sampling two frames and one 10 s audio segment per clip. No encoder is frozen. We use AdamW with β = ( 0.9 , 0.98 ) \beta=(0.9,0.98) , weight decay 0.01 0.01 and gradient-norm clipping at 2.0 2.0 . The learning rate is 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} for the backbone, 5 × 10 − 7 5\times 10^{-7} for the EVA-CLIP visual encoder and 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} for the hypergraph module, with linear warm-up over the first 10 % 10\% of the steps followed by linear decay.
blocks.zh: HyVol , wHyVol和wRHG在两个主干上共享相同的优化和数据设置. 从VAST检查站开始,我们用256个剪辑、两个帧取样和每个剪辑一个10个音频段的全球批次,在回收的训练装置上对每个模型进行一个时代(533个步骤)的培训。 没有编码器被冻结。 我们使用 AdamW 的 β = (0.9, 0.98)\beta = (0.9, 0.98), 重量衰减 0.01 和 梯度规范剪接 2. 0 . 学习率为:骨干2×10−5 2\times 10\times 10\times 5\times 10\times 7\times 10\times 10\times 7\times EVA-CLIP视觉编码器 5×10~4 5\times 10\times 4\times 10\times 4\tims 5),在最初的10% 10\tims 之后的线性衰减中,线性取暖.

blocks.en: We split the batch across four GPUs, and each GPU builds its hypergraph from its own 64 clips, so each GPU’s batch also forms the pool of semantic neighbors. All three configurations use k = 12 k=12 , which gives k eff = 12 k_{\mathrm{eff}}=12 in Eq. ( 1 ), no similarity filter, a semantic-edge dropout of 0.3 0.3 , and L = 2 L=2 propagation layers. The auxiliary weights in Eq. ( 10 ) are λ doc = 1.0 \lambda_{\mathrm{doc}}=1.0 for pooled caption–candidate alignment, λ reg = 0.1 \lambda_{\mathrm{reg}}=0.1 for variance regularisation (with stability constant 10 − 4 10^{-4} ), and λ itm = 0.1 \lambda_{\mathrm{itm}}=0.1 for the matching loss. The volume-based retrieval and alignment losses use label smoothing of 0.1 0.1 . Table 8 in Appendix C lists all hyperparameters.
blocks.zh: 我们把批次分成了四个GPU,每个GPU用自己的64个片段来构建它的超平面图,因此每个GPU的批次也组成了语义相邻的集合. 所有三种配置都使用 k = 12 k = 12,这给 k eff = 12 k_{\ mathrm{eff}}=12 在 Eq ( 1) 中,没有相似度过滤器,语义尖端退出 0.3 0.3,L = 2 L = 2 传播层. Eq. (10)中的辅助权重是:\\ doc = 1.0\lambda\ mathrm{doc}1.0 集合标题 – candidate 校正,\\ reg = 0.1\lambda\ mathrm{reg}0.1 差异正则化(稳定性常数为 10–4 10^{-4}),和\ itm = 0.1\lambda\ mathrm{itm}0.1 匹配损失. 基于量的检索和对齐损失使用标签平滑0.10.1. 附录中的表8 C列出所有超参数.

blocks.en: The three configurations differ only in their hypergraph weighting and propagation, as defined in Section 3.7 . For all three configurations on HyperGram , we retain the authors’ hybrid-geometry settings: a learnable curvature initialized to 1 1 , learnable Euclidean and hyperbolic weights initialized to 0.5 0.5 , and hyperbolic gradient clipping at 1.0 1.0 .
blocks.zh: 如第3.7节所定义的,三种配置仅在其高频加权和传播方面有所不同。 对于HyperGram上的所有三种配置,我们保留了作者的混合几何设置:可学习曲率初始化为11;可学习的Euclidean和双曲分量初始化为0.5;双曲梯度剪接为1.01.0。

blocks.en: We apply hypergraph refinement to the observed candidate modalities during training. Training captions guide the construction of semantic neighborhoods but are not included as candidate vertices. Missing modalities are excluded from the hypergraph, so they contribute neither vertex features nor propagated messages. At inference, we discard the hypergraph, propagation layers, and auxiliary pooling head, and retrieve scores using the corresponding backbone’s scoring function in Eq. ( 9 ). Consequently, the refinement configurations introduce no additional hypergraph computation during retrieval and require no neighborhood construction over evaluation candidates.
blocks.zh: 在培训期间,我们对所观察到的候选模式进行了改进。 培训说明指导了语义学街区的建设,但不列为候选顶点. 缺失的模式被排除在超文本图中,因此它们既不提供顶点特征,也不传播消息. 推论一下,我们放弃了高分图、传播层和辅助集合头,并使用相应的骨干在Eq.(9)的分数函数取回分数。 因此,改进的配置在检索过程中没有引入额外的超文本图计算,也不要求对评价候选人进行周边建设。

blocks.en: Table 1 lists the sampling used at test time. Eight frames are sampled for every candidate that contains video, and audio is represented by one or two 10 s segments depending on the benchmark. Queries are truncated to 40 or 70 tokens, which accommodates the different clip durations and description lengths of the benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 表1列出了试验时使用的取样。 八帧对每个包含视频的候选者进行抽样,音频根据基准由一到两个十段代表. 查询被缩短为40或70个令牌,可以容纳基准的不同剪接时间和描述长度.

blocks.en: We validate ten times during the epoch on the MSR-VTT 1k split in the T–VAS setting and keep the checkpoint with the highest text-to-video R@1 of the matching score. MSR-VTT is therefore the only benchmark used for model selection; the other ten benchmarks are used exclusively for testing. The neighbourhood size k k was likewise chosen from the sweep in Section 4.3.4 , which uses four of the evaluation benchmarks; a single value is used for all benchmarks and configurations.
blocks.zh: 在MSR-VTT 1k的时代,我们在T-VAS设置中进行10次验证,并保留比对分最高的文本到视频R@1的检查点。 因此,MSR-VTT是用于模型选择的唯一基准;其他10个基准完全用于测试。 街区面积kk也是从第4.3.4节的扫描中选择的,该节使用了四项评价基准;所有基准和配置都使用单一值。

blocks.en: All models are trained on four NVIDIA A100 GPUs with fp16 mixed precision, while hypergraph aggregation is computed in float32 for numerical stability. Following Gram [ 8 ] and HyperGram [ 28 ] , which report results from a single training run, we train each configuration once.
blocks.zh: 所有模型都以fp16混合精度的4个NVIDIA A100 GPU进行训练,而高分图聚合则用浮点32来计算数值稳定性. 在Gram[8]和HyperGram[28]报告一次训练的结果之后,我们每个配置都训练一次。

blocks.en: 4.3 Zero-Shot Retrieval Performance
blocks.zh: 4.3 零取暖性能

blocks.en: We evaluate retrieval performance across the eleven benchmarks described in Section 4.1.2 . Tables 2 and 3 report text-to-video and video-to-text retrieval, respectively, while Table 5 presents both directions of audio–text retrieval. We first examine improvements over the corresponding backbone, then compare refinement configurations and their behavior across modalities. All improvements discussed below are absolute differences in R@1, expressed in percentage points.
blocks.zh: 我们评价第4.1.2节所述的11个基准的检索业绩。 表2和表3分别报告了从视频到视频和从视频到文本的检索,而表5则介绍了音频-文本检索的两个方向。 我们首先审查相应的骨干上的改进,然后比较完善的配置及其跨模式的行为. 下文讨论的所有改进都是以百分点表示的R@1的绝对差异.

blocks.en: 4.3.1 Video–text retrieval
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 视频文本检索

blocks.en: Hypergraph refinement improves retrieval across a broad range of benchmarks. With Gram , wRHG outperforms the backbone in all 17 text-to-video settings and all 17 video-to-text settings. With HyperGram , it improves 16 of the 17 text-to-video settings and all 17 video-to-text settings. These results show that the benefits extend across both backbone formulations and retrieval directions, although their magnitude depends on the benchmark and available modalities. Figure 3 visualizes these results in the T–VA setting, with the minimum and maximum R@1 of each benchmark shown below its name.
blocks.zh: 超图改进改进了各种基准的检索。 有了Gram , wRHG在全部17个文本到视频设置和全部17个视频到文本设置中都超越了主干. HyperGram 改进了17个文本到视频设置中的16个,以及所有17个视频到文本设置. 这些结果表明,这些效益涵盖主干公式和检索方向,尽管其规模取决于基准和现有模式。 图3可视化这些结果在T-VA设置中,每个基准的最低和最高R@1在名称下方显示。

blocks.en: ActivityNet exhibits particularly substantial improvements. In the T–VA setting, Gram + wRHG increases text-to-video R@1 from 56.4 to 60.7 and video-to-text R@1 from 49.7 49.7 to 63.0 63.0 . HyperGram + wRHG shows a similar pattern, increasing the corresponding scores from 56.8 56.8 to 60.9 60.9 and from 50.9 50.9 to 63.0 63.0 . The larger gains in video-to-text retrieval indicate that the effect of refinement is not symmetric across retrieval directions. Although both directions use the same compatibility scores, ranking candidates for each textual query and ranking descriptions for each video impose different retrieval conditions.
blocks.zh: 活动网显示出特别重大的改进。 在T-VA设置中,Gram + wRHG将文本到视频的R@1从56.4增加到60.7,视频到文本的R@1从49.7 49.7增加到63.0 63.0. 超强 Gram + wRHG显示类似模式,将相应的分数从56.8 56.8分增加到60.9 60.9分和从50.9 50.9分增加到63.0 63.0. 视频到文本检索的较大收益表明,改进的效果并不是跨检索方向的对称. 虽然两个方向使用相同的相容分数,但每个文本查询的排名候选人和每个视频的排名描述都规定了不同的检索条件.

blocks.en: The weighted configurations improve on HyVol [ 29 ] in several settings. On ActivityNet T–VA, replacing HyVol with wHyVol increases Gram text-to-video R@1 from 56.9 to 60.8 and video-to-text R@1 from 56.6 to 62.7. With HyperGram , the corresponding scores increase from 57.8 to 60.5 and from 56.4 to 62.8. The consistent pattern across backbones indicates that the weighted configuration is particularly effective on ActivityNet.
blocks.zh: 加权配置在多个场合的HyVol[29]上有所改进. 在ActiveNet T-VA上,用wHyVol来取而代之的HyVol将Gram文本到视频R@1从56.9增加到60.8,视频到文本R@1从56.6增加到62.7. HyperGram),相应的分数从57.8分增加到60.5分,从56.4分增加到62.8分. 整个主干网的一贯模式表明加权配置对活动网特别有效。

blocks.en: Relational modeling provides further benefits in selected settings. On Shot2Story text-to-video retrieval with Gram , wRHG reaches 76.7 in T–V and 77.4 in T–VA, compared with 75.6 and 76.3 for wHyVol . On MSR-VTT video-to-text retrieval in T–V, wRHG improves over wHyVol from 55.1 to 56.5 with Gram and from 55.2 to 55.9 with HyperGram . These comparisons identify settings in which explicit modeling of distinct interactions provides improvements over weighted additive propagation.
blocks.zh: 关系模型化在所选环境中提供了进一步的好处. 在Shot2 Story文本到视频的Gram检索中,WRHG在T-V中达到76.7分,在T-VA中达到77.4分,而wHyVol则达到75.6分和76.3分. 在T-V的MSR-VTT视频到文本检索中,wRHG比wHyVol的Gram改进了55.1到56.5,比HyperGram改进了55.2到55.9。 这些比较查明了明确模拟不同相互作用的环境,这些环境比加权添加剂传播有所改善。

blocks.en: The ordering of the configurations is nevertheless not uniform. HyVol [ 29 ] achieves the highest text-to-video score on MSVD for both backbones, reaching 75.8. It also outperforms the weighted configurations on Shot2Story video-to-text retrieval and VALOR-32K video-to-text retrieval. Thus, the additional weighting and relational mechanisms provide benchmark-dependent benefits rather than consistent improvement across settings. Section 4.3.4 examines one such design choice, the neighbourhood size, under otherwise fixed settings.
blocks.zh: 然而,配置的顺序并不统一。 HyVol [29] 在MSVD上实现了两种骨干最高的文本对视频分数,达到75.8. 它还超过了Shot2 Story视频到文本检索和VALOR-32K视频到文本检索的加权配置. 因此,额外的权重和关系机制提供了取决于基准的效益,而不是各环境的一致改进。 第4.3.4节审查了这种设计选择,即邻里面积,在本来固定的设置下。

blocks.en: Additional candidate streams can improve retrieval when they provide information relevant to the query. On MSR-VTT, Gram + wRHG increases text-to-video R@1 from 53.0 53.0 with video alone to 54.7 54.7 with video and audio, and to 57.4 57.4 when subtitles are also included. HyperGram + wRHG follows the same trend, achieving 54.2 54.2 , 55.1 55.1 , and 57.3 57.3 , respectively.
blocks.zh: 额外的候选流在提供与查询有关的信息时可以改进检索. 在MSR-VTT上,Gram + wRHG将文本到视频的R@1从仅带视频的53.0 53.0增加到有视频和音频的54.7 54.7,并在包含字幕时增加到57.4 57.4. 超强 Gram + wRHG也遵循同样的趋势,分别达到54.2 54.2 , 55.1 55.1 和 57.3 57.3 .

blocks.en: The contribution of audio is particularly pronounced on VALOR-32K, whose descriptions cover both visible and audible events. Adding audio increases text-to-video R@1 from 70.2 70.2 to 80.8 80.8 for Gram + wRHG and from 70.4 70.4 to 80.9 80.9 for HyperGram + wRHG . This pattern is consistent with the audiovisual content of the queries and illustrates the importance of evaluating fusion under annotations that describe the available streams.
blocks.zh: 音频的贡献在VALOR-32K上特别显著,其描述既涵盖可见也涵盖可听到的事件. 添加音频后,gram + wRHG的文本到视频R@1从70.2 70.2增加到80.8 80.8,HyperGram + wRHG的文本从70.4 70.4增加到80.9 80.9 . 这种模式与查询的视听内容一致,并说明了在描述现有流程的说明下评价聚变的重要性。

blocks.en: Additional modalities do not guarantee higher performance. On FLARE, HyperGram + wRHG obtains 52.8 52.8 in T–VA, slightly below the backbone score of 52.9 52.9 . Moreover, FLARE uses different descriptions for T–V and T–VA, so we cannot attribute their difference solely to the inclusion of audio. These results highlight the dependence of retrieval performance on the combination of candidate information, query content, and backbone.
blocks.zh: 其他方式不能保证业绩更高。 在FLARE上,HyperGram + wRHG在T-VA获得52.8 52.8分,略低于主干分52.9分. 52.9 (中文(简体) ). 此外,FLARE对T-V和T-VA使用不同的描述,所以我们不能把它们的区别完全归因于包含音频. 这些结果突出了检索业绩依赖候选人信息、查询内容和主干网的组合。

blocks.en: 4.3.2 Audio–text retrieval
blocks.zh: 4.3.2 音频文本检索

blocks.en: Table 5 shows that refinement also benefits audio–text retrieval, though the gains are less uniform than on the video benchmarks. On AudioCaps, all three configurations improve over their corresponding backbones in both retrieval directions. HyperGram + wHyVol yields the strongest results, increasing text-to-audio R@1 from 32.4 to 36.9 and audio-to-text R@1 from 33.2 to 37.5. HyperGram + wRHG reaches 36.8 and 36.2, respectively, indicating that relational propagation offers no additional advantage over weighted additive propagation in this setting.
blocks.zh: 表5显示,改进还有利于音频文本检索,尽管收益不如视频基准一致。 在AudioCaps上,这三种配置在两个检索方向上都比相应的骨干有所改进. 超强 gram + wHyVol产生最强的结果,将文本到音频的R@1从32.4增加到36.9,将音频到文本的R@1从33.2增加到37.5。 超强 gram + wRHG分别达到36.8和36.2,表明在这种环境下,相对的传播比加权添加剂的传播没有额外的优势。

blocks.en: Clotho reveals a stronger dependence on the configuration and retrieval direction. For text-to-audio retrieval, HyVol [ 29 ] reduces R@1 from 11.9 to 11.0 with Gram and from 12.9 to 11.5 with HyperGram . The weighted configurations recover part or all of this loss: Gram + wHyVol reaches 13.2, while HyperGram + wRHG reaches 13.0. In audio-to-text retrieval, wHyVol achieves the highest score for both backbones, increasing R@1 from 11.5 to 15.0 with Gram and from 12.1 to 13.7 with HyperGram .
blocks.zh: 克洛多揭示出对配置和取回方向的更依赖. 对于从文本到音频的检索,HyVol[29]将R@1与Gram从11.9减少到11.0,与HyperGram从12.9减少到11.5。 加权配置收回部分或全部损失: gram + wHyVol 达到 13.2,而HyperGram + wRHG 达到 13.0. 在音频到文本检索中,wHyVol实现了两个主干线的最高得分,将R@1与格拉姆的比分从11.5提高到15.0,将HyperGram的比分从12.1提高到13.7.

blocks.en: On SoundDescs, improvements are small by comparison, and HyVol achieves the highest scores among the refinement configurations for both backbones and retrieval directions. For example, Gram + HyVol increases text-to-audio R@1 from 3.6 to 4.6, while HyperGram + HyVol increases it from 3.9 to 4.5. The low absolute recall indicates that this benchmark remains challenging under the evaluated training and retrieval protocol.
blocks.zh: 在SoundDescs上,通过比较改进是很小的,而HyVol在主干和检索方向的改进配置中都实现了最高分. 例如,Gram + HyVol将文本到音频的R@1从3.6增加到4.6,而HyperGram + HyVol将其从3.9增加到4.5. 绝对召回率低表明,根据经评估的培训和检索协议,这一基准仍然具有挑战性。

blocks.en: Unlike AudioCaps, Clotho and SoundDescs contain only audio on the candidate side. Their results therefore assess transfer to unimodal candidates rather than the direct benefit of combining multiple streams at inference. They demonstrate that training-time refinement can benefit audio-only retrieval, while also showing that the more elaborate configurations are not consistently preferable in this setting.
blocks.zh: 与AudioCaps不同,克洛多和SoundDescs只包含候选方的音频. 因此,它们的结果评估了向单一模式候选人的转让,而不是在推论中将多个流合并的直接好处。 它们表明,改进培训时间可以有利于只进行音频检索,同时也表明,在此情况下,较复杂的配置并非一贯可取。

blocks.en: 4.3.3 Comparison with existing methods
blocks.zh: 4.3.3 与现有方法的比较

blocks.en: Table 6 compares video retrieval results with those of existing methods, grouped by available candidate modalities. Both Gram + wRHG and HyperGram + wRHG outperform the re-evaluated PMRL checkpoint [ 25 ] in every reported setting in this table. On ActivityNet T–VA, for example, PMRL obtains 54.1 for text-to-video retrieval and 48.6 for video-to-text retrieval, compared with 60.9 and 63.0 for HyperGram + wRHG . On MSR-VTT T–VAS, HyperGram + wRHG achieves 57.3 and 59.3, compared with 54.3 and 52.9 for PMRL .
blocks.zh: 表6将视频检索结果与按现有候选模式分类的现有方法的视频检索结果进行比较。 Gram + wRHG 和 HyperGram + wRHG 都超过了本表中每个报告设置中重新评价的 PMRL 检查站[25] 。 例如,在ActiveNet T-VA上,PMRL获得54.1的文本到视频检索和48.6的视频到文本检索,而HyperGram + wRHG则获得60.9和63.0. 在MSR-VTT T-VAS上,HyperGram + wRHG达到57.3和59.3,而PMRL则达到54.3和52.9.

blocks.en: The comparison with Triangle [ 7 ] is more mixed. On VALOR-32K T–VA, Gram + wRHG reaches 80.8 for text-to-video retrieval, compared with 75.9 for Triangle . Conversely, Triangle obtains 56.1 on FLARE T–VA, exceeding the corresponding scores of 53.9 and 52.8 for Gram + wRHG and HyperGram + wRHG . On AudioCaps, Triangle also remains stronger than the refinement configurations, achieving 37.4 for text-to-audio retrieval and 38.2 for audio-to-text retrieval.
blocks.zh: 与三角[7]的比较则比较多. 在VALOR-32K T-VA上,Gram + wRHG的文本到视频检索达到80.8,而三角地区为75.9. 相反,三角在FLARE T-VA上获得56.1分,超过了Gram + wRHG和HyperGram + wRHG的相应分数53.9分和52.8分. 在AudioCaps上,三角也仍然比改进配置更强大,实现了从文本到音频检索的37.4和从音频到文本检索的38.2.

blocks.en: Table 7 provides additional context for AudioCaps text-to-audio retrieval. In the T–AV setting, Gram + wRHG and HyperGram + wRHG achieve 35.4 and 36.8, respectively, compared with 34.4 for the re-evaluated PMRL checkpoint. Published results obtained with other pretraining corpora or evaluation procedures are included as reference values. They establish the broader performance context but do not constitute controlled comparisons of fusion mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 表7提供了AudioCaps文本到音频检索的附加上下文. 在T-AV设置中,Gram + wRHG和HyperGram + wRHG分别实现了35.4和36.8,而重新评价的PMRL检查站则达到了34.4. 使用其他预训公司或评价程序获得的已公布结果列为参考值。 它们确定了更广泛的性能背景,但并不构成聚变机制的控制比较。

blocks.en: Increasing k k from 4 to 12 improves R@1 in every setting, and the effect is most pronounced for video-to-text retrieval. Averaged over the modality sets of each benchmark, the video-to-text gain is 6.6 points on MSR-VTT, 5.8 on DiDeMo, and 8.3 on ActivityNet; on VATEX, where R@1 already exceeds 90, it is 0.8 points. blocks.en: 4.4 Robustness to Missing Modalities
blocks.zh: 4.4 失踪方式的健全性

blocks.en: We further evaluate retrieval when individual clips lose part of their multimodal information. Unlike the complete-modality comparisons, this setting introduces heterogeneous observations within the same collection: some clips retain all available streams, while others are represented by a reduced modality set. Figures 4 – 7 examine whether improvements obtained through training-time hypergraph refinement persist under these conditions.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评价当个别剪辑丢失其部分多式联运信息时的检索。 与完全模式性比较不同,这种设置引入了同一集合中的多样的观测:一些剪辑保留了所有可用的流,而另一些则以缩小的模式集来代表. 图4 -- -- 7审查了在这种条件下是否继续通过改进培训时间的超速图来改进。

blocks.en: 4.4.1 Evaluation protocol
blocks.zh: 4.4.1 评价协议

blocks.en: The evaluation covers seven video benchmarks: MSR-VTT, DiDeMo, ActivityNet, VATEX, Shot2Story, FLARE, and VALOR-32K. MSR-VTT and VATEX use the T–VAS setting, while the remaining benchmarks use T–VA. MSVD is excluded because its evaluation configuration contains only video.
blocks.zh: 评价涵盖7个视频基准:MSR-VTT、DieMo、活动网、VATEX、Shot2 Story、FLARE和VALOR-32K。 MSR-VTT和VATEX使用T-VAS设置,而其余的基准使用T-VA. MSVD被排除在外,因为其评价配置只包含视频.

blocks.en: For a fraction r r of the clips, one randomly selected modality is removed. We consider missingness rates of 0%, 25%, 50%, 75%, and 90%, with 0% corresponding to the standard evaluation setting. The per-clip masks are fixed and identical across methods, ensuring that performance differences are measured under the same availability conditions. Each affected clip retains two modalities in T–VAS and one modality in T–VA. Thus, the missingness rate specifies the proportion of incomplete clips rather than the proportion of all modality observations removed.
blocks.zh: 对于片段 r r , 一个随机选择的模式被删除 。 我们认为,失踪率是0%、25%、50%、75%和90%,与标准评价设定相对应的是0%。 每张相片口罩是固定的,各方法相同,确保性能差异在相同的可用条件下得到衡量. 每个受影响的片段保留两种T-VAS模式和一种T-VA模式。 因此,缺失率指定了不完整剪辑的比例,而不是删除所有模式观察的比例.

blocks.en: The affected clips serve as gallery items in text-to-video retrieval and as queries in video-to-text retrieval. Figures 4 and 5 report results with Gram , while Figures 6 and 7 report results with HyperGram . Each curve shows the difference in R@1 between a refinement configuration and its corresponding backbone at the same missingness rate. Positive values therefore indicate an advantage over the backbone under incomplete observations; they do not imply that absolute retrieval performance is unchanged as modalities become unavailable. Table 9 in Appendix D lists the underlying R@1 values for each method compared at each missingness rate.
blocks.zh: 受影响的剪辑作为从文本到视频检索的图片库项目和从视频到文本检索的查询。 图4和图5报告了Gram的结果,而图6和图7报告了HyperGram的结果。 每个曲线都以相同的缺失率显示一个完善配置与其相应的主干之间的R@1差异. 因此,正值表明在不完全观察下比主干线有优势;它们并不意味着绝对检索性能没有变化,因为无法使用模式。 附录D的表9列出了每种方法的基本R@1值,与每种缺失率进行比较。

blocks.en: 4.4.2 Results with Gram
blocks.zh: 4.4.2 与格拉姆有关的成果

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows that wHyVol and wRHG retain positive text-to-video gains over Gram on all seven benchmarks at every evaluated missingness rate. Their advantage therefore persists even when 90% of the clips lose one modality. Although the gains generally become smaller as missingness increases, the weighted configurations remain beneficial across the evaluated collections.
blocks.zh: 图4显示,wHyVol和wRHG在所有7个基准上按每一次评估的缺失率保持正向文本到视频收益。 因此,即使90%的片段失去了一种模式,其优势仍然存在。 虽然随着缺失的增加,收益一般会变小,但加权配置在整个评价的收集中仍然有益。

blocks.en: ActivityNet clearly distinguishes the weighted configurations from HyVol [ 29 ] . Without missing modalities, the T–VA gains over Gram are 4.4 percentage points for wHyVol and 4.3 points for wRHG , compared with 0.5 0.5 points for HyVol . As shown in Figure 4 , both weighted configurations remain above the backbone throughout the missingness sweep, whereas HyVol falls below it at 25 25 %, 50 50 %, and 75 75 % missingness. The weighted configurations therefore maintain their advantage as audiovisual observations become incomplete.
blocks.zh: 活动 Net明确区分了加权配置与HyVol [29]. 没有缺少模式,WHyVol的T-VA增益为4.4个百分点,WRHG增益为4.3个百分点,而HyVol增益为0.5分. 如图4所示,在整个缺失扫描过程中,两个加权配置都高于主干,而HyVol则低于主干,分别为25.25%、50.50%和75%。 因此,由于视听观察不完整,加权配置保持了优势。

blocks.en: A similar distinction appears on MSR-VTT. In the complete T–VAS setting, wHyVol and wRHG improve over Gram by 5.0 and 5.6 points, respectively, compared with 4.0 points for HyVol . At 90% missingness, both weighted configurations remain positive, whereas HyVol falls slightly below the backbone. On VATEX, the weighted configurations also retain a larger advantage than HyVol at the highest missingness rate.
blocks.zh: MSR-VTT也有类似的区分. 在完整的T-VAS设置中,wHyVol和wRHG分别比Gram提高5.0分和5.6分,而HyVol的则提高4.0分. 90%的缺失率,这两个加权配置都保持正数,而HyVol略低于骨干. 在VATEX上,加权配置也保留了比HyVol更大的优势,其缺失率最高.

blocks.en: This ordering does not hold uniformly. On DiDeMo, HyVol provides a larger text-to-video gain than either weighted configuration at the nonzero missingness rates. On VALOR- 32 32 K, all three configurations remain above Gram throughout the sweep, and their gains do not decrease monotonically. These differences indicate that the relative benefit of weighting depends on the benchmark as well as the amount of missing information.
blocks.zh: 此命令并不统一 。 在DiDeMo上,HyVol提供的文本到视频增益大于非零缺失率的加权配置. 在VALOR-32 32 K上,所有三种配置在整个扫射过程中都保持在格拉姆之上,它们的收益不会单调地减少. 这些差异表明,加权的相对好处取决于基准和缺失信息的数量。

blocks.en: For video-to-text retrieval, Figure 5 shows positive gains for all three refinement configurations across all evaluated missingness rates. The gains generally narrow as more clips become incomplete. On ActivityNet, the complete-modality improvements of 13.0 points for wHyVol and 13.3 points for wRHG decrease with missingness, but both configurations remain above HyVol throughout the sweep. On VATEX, the weighted configurations likewise retain a clearer advantage at high missingness rates. Overall, the Gram results show that refinement remains beneficial under incomplete observations, while the magnitude and ordering of the improvements vary across datasets.
blocks.zh: 对于视频到文本检索, 图5显示,在所有评估的缺失率中,所有三项完善配置都取得了积极成果。 随着更多的片段变得不完整,收益一般缩小。 在ActiveNet上,WHyVol的13.0分和WRHG的13.3分的完整模式改进因缺失而减少,但在整个扫描过程中,这两个配置都保持在HyVol之上. 在VATEX上,加权配置同样保留了较高的缺失率更清晰的优势. 总体而言,格拉姆结果显示,在不完全观测的情况下,改进仍然有益,而改进的程度和顺序则因数据集而异。

blocks.en: 4.4.3 Results with HyperGram
blocks.zh: 4.4.3 带有超奶奶的结果

blocks.en: The HyperGram results in Figures 6 and 7 vary more across benchmarks. On MSR-VTT and ActivityNet, both weighted configurations retain positive gains in both retrieval directions at every evaluated missingness rate. However, Shot2Story and FLARE include conditions where refinement offers little benefit or underperforms the backbone.
blocks.zh: 图6和图7中的HyperGram结果因基准而异。 在MSR-VTT和ActiveNet上,两个加权配置都保留了每个评估的缺失率在两个检索方向上的积极收益. 然而,Shot2 Story和FLARE包括一些条件,即精细的改进没有带来什么好处,或表现不佳。

blocks.en: On ActivityNet text-to-video retrieval, wHyVol and wRHG improve over HyperGram by 3.7 3.7 and 4.1 4.1 points in the complete T–VA setting, compared with 1.0 1.0 point for HyVol . Figure 6 shows that both weighted configurations remain above the backbone at all four nonzero missingness rates, whereas HyVol falls below it. The video-to-text results in Figure 7 show the same preference for the weighted configurations: their initial gains of 11.9 and 12.1 points decrease with missingness but remain positive, while HyVol falls below HyperGram at 90 90 % missingness.
blocks.zh: 关于活动 净文本到视频检索,wHyVol和wRHG在完整的T-VA设置中比HyperGram改进了3.7和4.1 4.1分,而HyVol则提高了1.0分. 图6显示,这两种加权配置都高于主干,所有四种非零缺失率,而HyVol则低于主干率。 图7的视频到文本显示对加权配置的偏好相同:其初始收益为11.9分和12.1分,因缺失而减少,但仍为正数;而HyVol则以90%的缺失率低于HyperGram.

blocks.en: VATEX illustrates the importance of retrieval direction. All three configurations remain above HyperGram in text-to-video retrieval, although their relative ordering changes across the sweep. In video-to-text retrieval, wRHG maintains a positive margin throughout, while wHyVol ’s advantage approaches zero at 90 90 % missingness. HyVol falls below the backbone at 75 75 % and 90 90 % missingness. The relational configuration therefore provides the most persistent video-to-text advantage on this benchmark.
blocks.zh: VATEX说明了检索方向的重要性. 所有三种配置在从文本到视频的检索中都保留在HyperGram之上,尽管其相对的顺序变化贯穿了整个扫描. 在视频到文本检索中,wRHG在整个过程中保持正比值,而wHyVol的优势则以90-90%的缺失率接近0. HyVol以75-75%和90-90%的缺失率低于骨干. 因此,关系配置在这一基准上提供了最持久的视频对文本优势。

blocks.en: The Shot2Story results establish a limitation. In text-to-video retrieval, wRHG ’s advantage becomes negligible at 90 90 % missingness, while HyVol and wHyVol underperform the backbone at several rates. In video-to-text retrieval, all three configurations fall below HyperGram at the highest missingness rate. The improvement observed with complete observations therefore does not consistently transfer to severely incomplete clips on this benchmark.
blocks.zh: Shot2故事结果确立了限制。 在从文本到视频的检索中,wRHG的优势以90-90%的缺失率变得可以忽略不计,而HyVol和wHyVol则以数个速率低估了骨干. 在视频到文本检索中,所有三种配置都以最高的缺失率低于HyperGram. 因此,通过全面观察观察到的改进,不能一贯地转到这一基准上严重不完整的片段。

blocks.en: FLARE also exhibits non-monotonic behavior. In text-to-video retrieval, all three configurations underperform HyperGram at 25 25 %, 50 50 %, and 75% missingness, then show gains at 90 90 %. In video-to-text retrieval, all three fall below the backbone at 75 75 % missingness and recover positive gains at 90 90 %. Since these curves report differences from a backbone whose performance also changes with missingness, such recoveries do not imply an increase in absolute recall.
blocks.zh: FLARE还展现出非情绪行为. 在从文本到视频的检索中,所有三种配置都以25%,50%和75%的缺失率低于超奶奶,然后以90%显示增益. 在从视频到文本的检索中,所有三个都以75-75%的缺失率低于主干线,以90%恢复正收益. 由于这些曲线报告的一个骨干骨干存在差异,其业绩也因缺失而发生变化,因此这种回收并不意味着绝对召回的增加。

blocks.en: Taken together, Figures 4 – 7 show that the weighted configurations frequently preserve their advantage under incomplete observations, with particularly consistent results for Gram . The exceptions with HyperGram demonstrate that this advantage is not universal. Moreover, the hypergraph is absent during evaluation: the observed benefits arise through the learned encoder parameters, rather than through reconstruction of missing streams or information exchange between evaluation clips.
blocks.zh: 总体来看,图4-7显示加权配置经常在不完全观察下保持优势,格拉姆的结果尤其一致。 HyperGram的例外情况表明,这一优势并不普遍。 此外,在评价期间没有高频图:观察到的效益来自学到的编码器参数,而不是重建缺失的流或评价片段之间的信息交流。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: The refinement never touches the test-time score, yet all three configurations improve both backbones on almost every video setting. The only path from the hypergraph to retrieval is the encoder weights, so the gains indicate that the encoders learn more useful per-modality embeddings when related clips can supply evidence during training. Several of the largest gains occur where the backbone is weak; for example, in ActivityNet video-to-text, Gram obtains 49.7 49.7 R@1 and wRHG 63.0 63.0 , and in FLARE in the T–VA setting, wRHG raises Gram ’s text-to-video R@1 from 46.0 46.0 to 53.9 53.9 . In this sense the hypergraph acts as a fusion mechanism that operates across samples during learning rather than across modalities at inference.
blocks.zh: 精细度从未触及到测试时间分数,然而这三种配置几乎在每个视频设置上都改进了两个主干. 从高频图取回的唯一路径是编码器的权重,因此收益表明编码器在相关剪辑可以在训练期间提供证据时会学习更有用的通式嵌入. 几个最大的收益出现在骨干薄弱的地方;例如,在ActiveNet视频到文本中,Gram获得49.7 49.7 R@1和wRHG 63.0 63.0,在FLARE中,wRHG将Gram的文本到视频R@1从46.0 46.0提高到53.9。 53.9 (中文(简体) ). 从这个意义上讲,高频图是一种聚变机制,在学习过程中在样本中运行,而不是在推断时在模式中运行。

blocks.en: The two extensions address different weaknesses of HyVol , and the results separate them only partly. The weighted configuration produces the clearest change: on ActivityNet it raises video-to-text R@1 by about six points over HyVol with both backbones, and it keeps the gain under missing modalities where HyVol falls below the backbone. Typed relations add a further but smaller improvement, mainly on Shot2Story and MSR-VTT, and on several benchmarks wHyVol and wRHG are within a few tenths of a point of each other. A plausible reading is that deciding how much a view or a neighbour contributes matters more for low-quality data than deciding what kind of link connects them. HyVol remains the best configuration for MSVD text-to-video and for SoundDescs, so the added weighting and typing are not uniformly beneficial.
blocks.zh: 两个扩展处理HyVol的不同弱点,结果只将它们部分分开. 加权配置产生最明显的变化:关于活动 网能将视频到文本的R@1与HyVol相比提高了约6分,同时使用两个骨干,并将收益保持在HyVol低于骨干部的缺失模式下. 所打出的关系又增加了进一步但更小的改进,主要在Shot2 Story和MSR-VTT上,在几个基准上wHyVol和wRHG在相去相去一分之数以内. 一个合理的理解是,决定一个观点或邻居对低质量数据的贡献有多大,而不是决定何种连接它们。 HyVol仍然是MSVD从文本到视频和SoundDescs的最佳配置,因此所添加的权重和打字没有统一的好处.

blocks.en: Gains are generally larger for video-to-text than for text-to-video retrieval, reaching 13.3 13.3 points on ActivityNet against 4.3 4.3 in the other direction. The backbone scores are the same in both directions, but the rankings are formed over different sets. One possible explanation is that the refinement acts on the video embeddings, which are the side exposed to related clips during training, so a better-organised video space benefits most directly the direction in which videos act as queries.
blocks.zh: 视频到文本的收益通常大于从文本到视频的检索收益,在ActiveNet上达到13.3 13.3分,而在另一方向则为4.3 4.3分. 骨干分数在两个方向上都是一样的,但排名是在不同档次上形成的. 一种可能的解释是,在视频嵌入上的精炼行为,即培训期间接触相关剪辑的一面,因此一个组织较好的视频空间最直接地有利于视频作为查询的方向.

blocks.en: The missing-modality study shows that the benefit of training-time fusion largely survives when views disappear at test time, although the models never see incomplete clips during training. With Gram , both weighted configurations remain above the backbone on all seven benchmarks at every rate, suggesting that learned vertex weights reduce the embeddings’ dependence on any single stream. The HyperGram results are less regular, and on two benchmarks with long or multi-shot videos some conditions show no benefit, possibly because removing a stream there changes which modality carries the most information. On the audio benchmarks, gains are smaller and less consistent, which indicates that exchange between related clips is most useful when each clip offers several complementary streams to fuse.
blocks.zh: 缺失模式研究显示,在测试时视线消失时,培训时间聚变的好处基本上可以活下来,尽管模型在培训期间从未看到不完整的片段. Gram),这两种加权配置在所有7个基准上都以每个速率都高于主干,说明所学的顶点权重会减少嵌入物对任何单一流的依赖. HyperGram的结果不太正常,在有长镜头或多镜头视频的两个基准上,有些条件显示没有好处,可能是因为删除了其中包含最多信息的流。 在音频基准方面,收益较小,也不太一致,这表明,当每道相接的相接相接相接的相接相接相接时,最有用。

blocks.en: Since no part of the hypergraph survives training, the refined models have the same parameters at inference, the same encoding cost and the same scoring function as their backbones, unlike test-time re-ranking and query-bank methods [ 49 , 1 ] . The approach can therefore be added to an existing volume-based retrieval system without changing its deployment; the only extra cost is a small hypergraph module during the same one-epoch training.
blocks.zh: 由于任何部分的超图都无法幸存训练,被精制的模型在推论上具有相同的参数,编码成本和打分功能都与其骨干相同,不同于测试时重排和查询-库方法[49, 1]. 因此,这一方法可以在不改变其部署的情况下被添加到现有的量取取系统中;唯一额外的费用是在同一个时代的训练期间一个小的超图模块.

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6 限制

blocks.en: All compared models use the VAST encoders. We apply our models ( HyVol , wHyVol , and wRHG ) to the two volume-based backbones, Gram and HyperGram . TRIANGLE [ 7 ] is evaluated exclusively as a baseline because it is designed for exactly three modalities. Its score corresponds to the area spanned by three embeddings, the three-vector case of the Gram volume; it therefore cannot incorporate subtitles as a fourth stream, and its underlying principle is already represented by Gram . PMRL [ 25 ] is also evaluated exclusively as a baseline because it adopts a different formulation: it aligns modalities by maximizing the leading singular value of their stacked embeddings, ranks candidates using a single fused representation, and assumes complete modality availability. In contrast, our models refine separate per-modality embeddings. Integrating them with PMRL would therefore require adapting its objective rather than directly incorporating our module. Extensions to PMRL and to encoders pretrained on other corpora remain directions for future research.
blocks.zh: 所有比较模型都使用VAST编码器. 我们把我们的模型(HyVol, wHyVol, 和 wRHG)应用到两个以量为基础的主干, Gram和HyperGram。 TRIANGLE [7] 完全作为基准加以评价,因为它是专门为三种模式设计的。 其得分与三个嵌入区相对应,即格莱克卷的三维子;因此它不能将字幕作为第四流,其根本原则已经由格莱克来代表. PMRL [25] 也完全被评价为一个基准,因为它采用了不同的提法:它通过最大程度地使用堆入式嵌入物的主要单值来协调模式,使用单一的引信代表物对候选人进行排名,并假设完全模式可用性. 相比之下,我们的模型完善了单独的通式嵌入。 因此,要将它们与PMRL相结合,就需要调整其目标,而不是直接纳入我们的模块。 对PMRL的扩展和对其他公司进行预先训练的编码器仍然是未来研究的方向.

blocks.en: Our models employ the hypergraph feature fusion exclusively during training, with its influence incorporated into the encoder weights. At inference, each clip is encoded and scored independently using the original backbone. Although this design preserves the inference cost, it constrains the model’s adaptability. Specifically, the deployed model cannot exploit gallery-specific structure, adapt to individual queries, or account for the particular pattern of missing streams encountered at test time. Such adaptation would require an explicit inference-time component, such as a lightweight graph constructed over the gallery, which lies beyond the scope of this work.
blocks.zh: 我们的模型完全在训练期间使用超图特性聚变,其影响被纳入编码器重量。 推断出,每个片段都是用原主干线进行编码并独立得分. 虽然这种设计保留了推论成本,但它限制了模型的适应性. 具体地说,所部署的模型不能利用专有的画廊结构,不能适应个别的查询,也不能说明测试时所遇到缺失流的特定模式. 这种调整需要明确的推论时间部分,例如画廊上绘制的轻量级图表,它超出了这项工作的范围。

blocks.en: Following Gram , PMRL , and HyperGram , we perform one epoch of continued pretraining on the 150K-clip subset of VAST-27M, of which 136,694 clips remained recoverable. Our conclusions are therefore restricted to this continued-pretraining regime and do not extend to training on the full corpus. Consistent with these studies, which do not report variability across repeated training runs, we train each configuration once using a fixed seed. All runs begin from the same pretrained checkpoint and differ only in the small hypergraph module. We therefore assess the consistency of improvements across eleven benchmarks and two backbones, rather than quantifying variability across repeated runs.
blocks.zh: 在Gram,PMRL,和HyperGram之后,我们对VAST-27M的150K-clip子集进行一个持续预训的时代,其中136,694个片段仍然可以回收. 因此,我们的结论仅限于这种继续训练制度,而不扩大到全面训练。 与这些研究相一致,这些研究并不报告反复培训的可变性,我们利用固定种子培训每个配置。 所有运行都从同一个经过预先训练的检查站开始,只在小的超平面模块中有所不同. 因此,我们评估11个基准和2个支柱的改进的一致性,而不是对反复进行的变动进行量化。

blocks.en: None of the compared backbones evaluates retrieval with missing modalities. We therefore adopt the protocol introduced in our conference version [ 29 ] , which, consistent with prior robustness studies [ 26 ] , removes one randomly selected stream per clip at test time. This controlled protocol ensures identical evaluation conditions across methods. However, it only approximates the structured patterns of missing data encountered in real-world collections, in which entire sources or recording conditions may be absent.
blocks.zh: 比较的骨干无法用缺失的模式评价检索. 因此,我们通过会议版本[29]中引入的议定书,根据先前的稳健性研究[26],在测试时间去掉每段随机选择的流. 这种受控协议确保不同方法的评价条件相同。 然而,它仅大致反映了现实世界收集中遇到的缺失数据的结构模式,其中可能没有全部来源或记录条件。

blocks.en: Following the released training configurations of Gram , Triangle , PMRL , and HyperGram , we select the checkpoint by validating on MSR-VTT, which is also one of our evaluation benchmarks. We never use the remaining ten benchmarks during training or model selection, and the gains on them are similar to those on MSR-VTT, indicating that our conclusions do not depend on this choice. A held-out validation set drawn from the training distribution would make the evaluation fully independent of model selection.
blocks.zh: 在发布了Gram、Triangle、PMRL和HyperGram的训练配置之后, 我们从未在培训或模式选择中使用其余10个基准,这些基准的收益与MSR-VTT相似,表明我们的结论并不取决于这一选择。 从培训分发情况中抽取的搁置论证将使得评价完全独立于模型选择。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We presented a hypergraph refinement framework for multimodal retrieval that models information exchange among observed modalities within a candidate and across semantically related training candidates. The framework includes HyVol as a special case and accommodates two additional configurations: wHyVol , which weights modality contributions and semantic connections, and wRHG , which additionally distinguishes relation types and participant roles. Missing modalities are naturally excluded from the hypergraph without imputation. We restrict refinement to training, while inference retains the corresponding backbone’s encoder outputs and retrieval scoring function.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个改进多模式检索的速记框架,该框架在候选人内部和在与培训目的密切有关的候选人之间对所观察到的模式进行信息交流。 框架包括了HyVol作为特例,并容纳了另外两个配置:wHyVol,它加权模式贡献和语义连接;和wRHG,它额外区分了关系类型和参与者角色. 缺失的模式自然被排除出超音速图中而不进行估算. 我们仅限于培训,而推论则保留相应的主干编码器输出和检索评分功能。

blocks.en: Evaluation on 11 11 zero-shot benchmarks demonstrates improvements across video–text and audio–text retrieval. With Gram , wRHG improves over the backbone in all 17 17 text-to-video settings and all 17 17 video-to-text settings. With HyperGram , it improves 16 16 of the 17 17 text-to-video settings and all 17 video-to-text settings. The missing-modality evaluation on seven video benchmarks further shows that the weighted configurations often retain their advantage when individual clips lose an observed stream.
blocks.zh: 对11个零镜头基准的评价表明,视频文本和音频文本检索工作有所改善。 WRHG在17个文本到视频设置和17个视频到文本设置中, HyperGram 改进了17个17个文本到视频设置中的16个,以及所有17个视频到文本设置. 对7个视频基准的缺失模式评价进一步显示,当单个片段失去被观测到的流时,加权配置往往保持优势.

blocks.en: The results also identify the boundaries of these benefits. No refinement configuration is uniformly strongest across datasets and retrieval directions. HyVol remains competitive or superior in several settings, audio-only retrieval exhibits smaller and less consistent gains, and some incomplete-modality conditions favor the unrefined HyperGram backbone. These findings support training-time hypergraph refinement as an effective approach to improving retrieval across evaluated settings, while showing that the value of weighting and relational modeling depends on the available information, backbone, and task.
blocks.zh: 结果还确定了这些效益的界限。 数据集和检索方向之间没有统一最强的改进配置。 HyVol在几个场合中仍然具有竞争力或优越性,只有音频的检索显示收益较小和不太一致,一些不完全的模式条件有利于未经改进的HyperGram主干线. 这些调查结果支持改进培训时间超时图,作为改进所有评价环境检索的有效办法,同时表明加权和关系模型的价值取决于现有信息、主干和任务。
